properties.description: The end of a class that took three increments to see clearly. A user reported two fields their tools would not take; the instrument built to find that class could not see them; once it could, the count was 43 and conflated a hole with a property an operation writes; split by intent it was 14; and this increment closes all 14. Eight constructors gained parameters and Actor gained the constructor it never had. The reachability report reads 0 HOLE, and the 28 that remain are unreachable on purpose.
